groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Safest Choice: Steamed & Fresh Vegetable Broths
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike the deep-fried meal sets, these steamed and boiled vegetable dishes provide essential fiber without heavy fats or excess sodium.
groups.message: These clear soups, steamed tofu packages (Pepes Tahu), and boiled greens offer exceptional nutritional value with minimal calories and negligible saturated fat. They help close your fiber deficit (currently 26% under target) while keeping sodium manageable. Enjoy these freely as primary side dishes to balance heavier proteins.
groups.orderingTip: Order an extra portion of Sayur Asem or Pepes Tahu to boost fiber intake without adding unwanted saturated fats.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Moderate Choice: Grilled Lean Proteins & Light Sautéed Greens
groups.comparisonSentence: These grilled and lightly sautéed selections provide better protein density than fried dishes, though sodium remains moderate.
groups.message: This group includes grilled chicken satay, clear broths with lean meats, plain white rice, and light vegetable stir-fries. They provide solid protein to support your daily goal (100g target) while avoiding the heavy batter and deep-frying oils found in Tier 3. Watch out for added sodium in broths, but overall these are much safer than fried alternatives.
groups.orderingTip: Opt for Sate Taichan or grilled proteins over fried variants to keep saturated fat well below your 38% excess threshold.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Caution: Deep-Fried Meal Sets & Coconut/Balado Dishes
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to steamed items, these deep-fried meal sets and coconut rice dishes significantly exacerbate your calorie and saturated fat overages.
groups.message: These packaged meal sets feature deep-fried poultry or fish alongside coconut-infused rice (Nasi Uduk) and spicy balado sauces. While they deliver ample protein, they are heavy contributors to your 39% calorie surplus and saturated fat overages. The frying oils and rich coconut milk also elevate inflammatory loads.
groups.orderingTip: Request steamed white rice instead of Nasi Uduk, and ask for grilled rather than fried protein options to cut down on saturated fat.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Alert: Salted Fish, Fried Cabbage, Seblak & Sugary Desserts
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike wholesome steamed dishes, these salted fish items, fried snacks, and desserts directly violate your sodium and added sugar targets.
groups.message: This high-risk group encompasses salted dried fish (Ikan Asin), oil-soaked fried cabbage (Kol Goreng), spicy wet crackers (Seblak), offal satays, and sugary coconut desserts. They deliver massive spikes of sodium (worsening your 3000mg average) and added sugars (exceeding your 45g target by 50%), posing significant metabolic strain.
groups.orderingTip: Strictly avoid salted fish, Kol Goreng, and sweet coconut ice desserts to prevent severe sodium and added sugar surges.
